name: ATMOSPHERE OS — ALIGNED SCENT CARDS
changes: Aligns all mobile Scent Consultation recommendation cards to the same top and bottom rhythm
Reserves consistent space for product names, descriptions and recommendation rationale
Normalizes the Why it fits, Reeds and Care rows without moving alternative cards downward
Keeps price and Add to cart actions aligned at the bottom of every swipe card
Preserves the one-card swipe rail, next-card preview and desktop layouts from v16.0.5
notes: The alignment override applies only at 680 px and below.
Long recommendation copy is limited to a readable mobile preview to keep card geometry consistent.
No product data, scoring, checkout, payment, Supabase schema or Edge Function logic changed.
